sources.name: California Statewide Parcels Public View (CAL FIRE)
sources.operator: California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (CAL FIRE), ArcGIS Online public view of a statewide county-parcel compilation
sources.scope: Statewide California county-parcel compilation (58 county FIPS codes present, 13,138,000 rows on 2026-10-12). Canonical identity is the county FIPS code plus the county assessor parcel number; the 23,032 rows without an APN are outside this source.
caveats: APNs are county-scoped number spaces, so identity is the reversible composite FIPS_CODE~PARCEL_APN; PARCEL_DMP_ID (an aggregator key with several batch prefixes) is not used.

Condominium-style rows repeat one APN with byte-identical lot geometry (e.g. 582 rows for one Los Angeles APN); the adapter keeps one polygon per APN. No APN with differing Shape__Area was found in Los Angeles, Sacramento, Orange or Contra Costa counties; a differing repeat elsewhere fails closed.
Distinct APNs can share one identical lot polygon (observed in Orange and Contra Costa bbox samples).
metricSrid 32611 suits southern California; cities west of 120 W need a per-city metric projection (e.g. 32610) when qualified.
Layer derives from a statewide compilation of county data (data last edited 2026-05-28); per-county currency was not established and no licence text is published in the service metadata.
